title: NAFC genomic-neighborhood analysis scripts, data and gene-map atlas
description: Scripts, data files and a browsable gene-map atlas for the article "Wetland-root microbial genomes contain recurrent multi-gene neighborhoods with potential relevance to naphthenic acid fractional compound transformation". Scripts cover MAG recovery and abundance, Prokka annotation, phylogenomics, a curated 667-protein reference-panel BLASTP screen of 365 genomes, candidate genomic-neighborhood reconstruction, iTOL dataset generation, architecture signatures, annotation confirmation, ROW versus OSPW comparison, and figure generation. Data files include the reference panel, BLASTP best-hit tables, candidate-neighborhood tables, the unified phylogenomic tree with iTOL annotation files, and Prokka annotations of all 365 genomes. The gene-map atlas (docs/) is viewable at https://julius-nweze.github.io/NAFC_genomic_neighborhoods/.
